Visual and interaction system

Every mark
has a reason.

The AI drafts. The teacher decides.

Insaaf means justice. The teacher’s marking pen becomes a clear record: words, criteria, judgement, then approval.

Paper and ink. Evidence before verdict.
Designed for a lecturer, not a landing page.

A scale of evidence, not a traffic light

FullBand 4 of 4
MostlyBand 3 of 4
PartialBand 2 of 4
MinimalBand 1 of 4
NoneBand 0 of 4

Bands are ordered rubric judgements, not marks. The partial-credit policy calculates marks separately. Labels preserve meaning without color.
